# routeros_system_certificate_settings (Resource)
Settings of `/certificate settings` (built-in trust store, CRL). Deleting the resource only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_certificate_settings" "this" {
  builtin_trust_store = ["fetch", "dns"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `builtin_trust_store` (Set of String) Services that trust the built-in CA store of RouterOS: `all`, `default`, `untrusted` or a list of services (`fetch`, `dns`, `container`, `www`, `reverse-proxy`, `ovpn`, ...; `/console inspect request=completion path=certificate,settings,set,builtin-trust-store` lists them for the RouterOS version).
- `crl_download` (Boolean) Download CRLs of the certificates automatically.
- `crl_store` (String) Where downloaded CRLs are stored: `ram` or `system`.
- `crl_use` (Boolean) Check certificates against CRLs.

### Read-Only

- `current_defaults` (String) Services that `builtin_trust_store = ["default"]` stands for on this RouterOS version.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_system_certificate_settings.this .
```
